Junior Cloud Engineer


Start your cloud infrastructure career with us!


We are looking for a Junior Cloud Engineer to join our infrastructure team and begin building hands-on experience in cloud-native environments. This role is about skill acquisition and reliability — you'll work under supervision on well-scoped infrastructure tasks, building the foundations you'll need to grow into a Standard Cloud Engineer and beyond on our Platform or SRE career paths.


You'll get close guidance from senior engineers as you learn Linux fundamentals, cloud basics, containers, and CI/CD — with room to grow at your own pace.


Responsibilities

· Infrastructure Support

· Support infrastructure tasks under supervision

· Write basic Infrastructure as Code (IaC) components

· CI/CD & Operations

· Maintain CI/CD pipelines with supervision

· Handle low-risk operational issues

· Monitoring & Troubleshooting

· Search logs and read dashboards to help investigate known issues

· Learn how incidents are declared and your role in escalating them

· Growth

· Build foundational knowledge of Linux, cloud, and containers

· Receive close guidance and mentorship from senior cloud/platform engineers


Requirements

· Less than 2 years of experience in this role

· Basic understanding of Linux command-line usage (navigation, file operations, permissions)

· Familiarity with core cloud concepts (compute, storage, networking) — hands-on portal experience is a plus

· Basic understanding of containers (Docker) — can read a Dockerfile and run a local stack via Compose

· Familiarity with Git and collaborative workflows (branches, merge requests)

· Basic understanding of security fundamentals (least privilege, not storing credentials in files)

· Eagerness to learn, ask for help when stuck, and grow within a structured mentorship path


Nice to Have

· Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (e.g. reading/modifying a Terraform configuration)

· Basic scripting experience (Bash or Python)

· Coursework or personal projects involving cloud platforms

· Familiarity with reading logs/dashboards to investigate an issue


What We Offer

Permanent contract.

Flexible working hours (core hours: 09:30 – 13:30).

Remote-first culture, with the option to work from our Granada office.

30 working days of annual leave, plus December 24th and December 31st as additional company days off that do not count against your holiday allowance.

Private health insurance.

Your choice of MacBook or Lenovo.

Continuous professional development:

· Unlimited access to learning platforms.

· Learning time during working hours.

· Budget for certifications and specialised training.

Employee referral programme.

Opportunity-based bonuses.

Stable, long-term projects.

Real opportunities for professional growth.

The opportunity to play a key role in the growth of a modern Software Engineering company.


Selection Process

1. With pleasure, we receive your CV and we give you a call

2. Now it’s when we put faces to names, we’d love to get to chat with you!

3. Let’s deepen a bit more with a technical interview, a chance to meet your People Partner

4. We get back to you with offer and feed


Salary Range

· €25,000 – €35,000
